scope: Ink contentPart anchor corrected to the DrawingML form required by Word; desktop Word round-trip verified

rootCause.problem: Word reported 'Word found unreadable content' for the saved ink file and refused to open it
rootCause.cause: The writer anchored ink with a plain w:contentPart inside w:r (ISO 29500 17.3.3.2 generic XML content). Word uses that element for MathML/SVG-style parts; an Ink content part must be a DrawingML contentPart: w:drawing > wp:anchor > a:graphicData uri=...wordprocessingInk > w14:contentPart, wrapped in mc:AlternateContent/mc:Choice Requires="w14" ([MS-ODRAWXML] 2.2.7.6)
isolation: ink part + relationship + content type, no anchor: Word opens, 546 pages
anchor as plain w:contentPart: Word reports unreadable content
anchor as DrawingML w14:contentPart: Word opens and draws the stroke

implementation.anchor: mc:AlternateContent > mc:Choice Requires=w14 > w:drawing > wp:anchor (behindDoc, wrapNone, page-relative) > a:graphic > a:graphicData(uri=http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordprocessingInk) > w14:contentPart r:id=rIdInk with w14:nvContentPartPr and w14:xfrm
implementation.placement: Anchored in the last paragraph of the cover table on page 1, not in the TOC sdt paragraph, so the TOC field is not split and Word pagination is unchanged
implementation.bounds: wp:extent and w14:xfrm use the stroke bounding box (page px -> EMU) so the drawing rectangle follows the drawn region
implementation.calibrationTrace: The InkML part carries a transparent full-page trace (xml:id=ink-canvas, brush transparency=255) so Word's internal ink canvas is the whole page; parser skips it
implementation.wordTransform: Measured Word scale/offset from 4 reference strokes is applied as an inverse when writing (X 1.132/+0.003, Y 1.238/+0.2216) and forward when parsing; parts written by this app carry oerp:calibrated=word so foreign InkML is left untouched
implementation.migration: Existing plain w:contentPart runs and old ink drawings are removed before inserting the DrawingML anchor
